key_stat: #1 global FinTech (IDC, 3 yrs) | 10K FI clients | 6M merchant locations | 90B transactions/year
summary: Fiserv is the world's largest FinTech, processing 90B transactions annually. Under pressure: stock dropped 40%+ in Oct 2025 after earnings miss and Clover fee complaints. New CEO Mike Lyons launched 'One Fiserv' action plan. Key products: Clover POS ($3.3B revenue 2025, +23%), Finxact cloud-native core (consolidating 16 US cores to 5), FIUSD stablecoin, INDX real-time settlement. Major leadership refresh: Co-Presidents (Georgakopoulos + Suryadevara), new CROs from JPMorgan and Stripe. Expanding Clover to 5 new countries including Brazil. TD Bank merchant partnership.
